content: We demonstrated the efficacy of this approach by applying qualitative and quantitative evaluations for interpretability. We also showed via standard word-analogy and word-similarity tests that the semantic coherence of the original vector space is preserved, even slightly improved. We have also performed and reported quantitative comparisons with several other methods for both interpretabilty increase and preservation of semantic coherence. Upon inspection of Fig. FIGREF18 and Tables TABREF20 , TABREF21 , and TABREF22 altogether, it should be noted that our proposed method achieves both of the objectives simultaneously, increased interpretability and preservation of the intrinsic semantic structure.
